items.titleZh: FIA解释勒克莱尔墨西哥站受罚依据
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联F1赛事干事解释了为何仅对勒克莱尔在墨西哥大奖赛首圈切弯超越汉密尔顿处以5秒罚时。
items.originalTitle: FIA explains controversial Leclerc penalty decision
items.summaryEn: The FIA Formula 1 stewards have explained why Charles Leclerc received only a five-second penalty for cutting the track and passing Lewis Hamilton for the lead on the opening lap of the Mexico Grand Prix.
detailZh: 国际汽联F1赛事干事解释了为何仅对夏尔·勒克莱尔处以5秒罚时，原因是他在墨西哥大奖赛首圈切弯并超越刘易斯·汉密尔顿取得领先。
这两位法拉利队友从起步起就争夺头名，在开场的连续弯角中已经并排行驶，随后勒克莱尔在4号弯外侧发起进攻。
两位车手都尽可能晚刹车，勒克莱尔冲出赛道、横穿草地，在5号弯后回到领先位置。
在他身后，汉密尔顿为防守而晚刹车，也略微跑宽，损失了动量，让身后的马克斯·维斯塔潘完成超越，抢走第二的位置。
赛道的这个区域和第一组弯角一样，适用一项特殊规则，以避免车手在开场圈耍花招，从草地上抄近道来获得位置。
在赛前发给车队的通知中，国际汽联在车手简报会讨论后表示：“任何赛车在这些区域离开赛道，并保持在紧邻后方一辆或多辆赛车（由赛会干事判定）之前的位置，都可能被视为获得了持久优势，除非该位置在第4弯（针对在第1至第3弯区域离开赛道的赛车）或第12弯（针对在第4至第6弯区域离开赛道的赛车）让出。”
由于勒克莱尔没有把位置让给汉密尔顿，因此他因获得优势而接受调查——最终决定对他处以5秒罚时。
但这引发了争议，尤其是汉密尔顿认为，鉴于勒克莱尔因处于干净空气中所获得的优势让他得以建立缓冲，处罚本应是标准的10秒。
汉密尔顿在跟随维斯塔潘身后排名第三时通过无线电表示：“五秒罚时的问题在于他获得了干净空气。他不必像我们其他人那样管理轮胎。”
他随后表示：“赛会干事基本上把这个冠军拱手送给了勒克莱尔……我们对此达成过一致，在车手简报会上。”
在解释为何勒克莱尔被处以五秒罚时的时候，国际汽联赛会干事表示存在减轻处罚的情节——其中包括汉密尔顿本人在防守领先位置时冲出了赛道。
赛会干事在声明中表示：“赛会干事认定两辆车都以过快速度进入4号弯，因此两车都无法在赛道上完成过弯，正如44号车（汉密尔顿）处于内线，不得不驶出赛道才能过弯所证明的那样。”
“因此，16号车[勒克莱尔]由于入弯速度过快，无权主张对该弯角的拥有权。该车手随后在赛道外完成了超车，因此这应当受到处罚。
“基准处罚标准是10秒，但减轻处罚的因素是，44号车在16号车内侧时也处于赛道外，而且这发生在第一圈早期。”
勒克莱尔的五秒罚时意味着他在第一次进站后掉到了维斯塔潘后面，随后瓦尔特利·博塔斯的撞车引发了红旗。
detailEn: The FIA Formula 1 stewards have explained why Charles Leclerc was only given a five-second penalty for cutting the track and passing Lewis Hamilton for the lead of the Mexico Grand Prix on the opening lap.
The Ferrari team-mates were duelling for the front spot from the start, having already gone side by side through the opening sequence of corners when Leclerc made a move on the outside of Turn 4.
Both drivers braked as late as possible, with Leclerc running wide and cutting across the grass before rejoining at the front after Turn 5.
Behind him Hamilton, in his attempt to defend by braking late, had run slightly wide - costing him momentum which allowed the pursuing Max Verstappen to make a move and snatch second spot.
This area of the track was, like the first corners, subject to a special rule to avoid shenanigans on opening laps of drivers cutting across the grass to gain positions.

In a note sent to teams ahead of the race, following discussions in the drivers' briefing, the FIA said: "Any car leaving the track in these areas and maintaining a position to a car or cars within close proximity behind (as determined by the stewards) may be considered as gaining a lasting advantage, unless such position is yielded by Turn 4 [in the case of a car leaving the track in the area of Turns 1 to 3], or by Turn 12 [in the case of a car leaving the track in the area of Turns 4 to 6.]”
With Leclerc having not given up the place to Hamilton, he was therefore put under investigation for gaining an advantage – and it was decided that he would get a five-second penalty.

That proved controversial though with Hamilton in particular feeling that, with the advantage that Leclerc gained from having clean air which allowed him to build up a buffer, the sanction should have been the standard 10 seconds.
In messages over his radio as he ran third behind Verstappen, Hamilton said: "[The] problem with the five second penalty is he's got clean air. He doesn't have to manage like the rest of us.”
He later said: "The stewards have basically handed Charles this win.... we agreed, drivers' briefing.”

In explaining why Leclerc was given a five-second penalty, the FIA stewards said that there were mitigating circumstances – which included Hamilton himself having run off the track as he defended the lead.

"The stewards have determined that both cars entered Turn 4 with excessive speed and therefore neither would have been able to make the corner on track, as demonstrated by the fact that car 44 [Hamilton] which was on the inside, had to go off track to make the corner," said the stewards in a statement.
"Car 16 [Leclerc] was therefore not entitled to claim the corner due to the excessive entry speed. The driver then completed an overtake whilst off track and accordingly this warrants a penalty.
"The baseline penalty guideline is 10 seconds, however in mitigation is the fact that car 44 was also off track on the inside of car 16 and this occurred early in the first lap.”
Leclerc's five second penalty meant he dropped behind Verstappen at his first stop, prior to the red flag being brought out by Valtteri Bottas's crash.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿在1至3号弯已并排缠斗，随后勒克莱尔在4号弯外侧发起进攻。
两人都尽可能晚刹车，勒克莱尔冲出赛道、横穿草地，在5号弯后回到领先位置。
汉密尔顿为防守晚刹车也略微跑宽，损失动量，让身后的维斯塔潘完成超越升至第二。
keyPointsEn: Leclerc and Hamilton had already gone side by side through the opening corners before Leclerc made his move on the outside of Turn 4.
Both drivers braked as late as possible; Leclerc ran wide and cut across the grass, rejoining at the front after Turn 5.
Hamilton ran slightly wide while defending by braking late, costing him momentum and allowing Max Verstappen to snatch second.

items.titleZh: 博塔斯墨西哥站撞墙退赛 接受预防性医疗检查
items.summaryZh: 博塔斯在墨西哥大奖赛第45圈右前悬挂失效撞墙，赛会出示红旗，他随后被送往医疗中心接受预防性检查。
items.originalTitle: Bottas taken for medical checks after race-stopping crash
items.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas crashed at the Mexican Grand Prix when his right front suspension failed on lap 45, bringing out the red flag, and he was taken to the medical centre for precautionary checks.
detailZh: 博塔斯在一场导致F1墨西哥大奖赛出示红旗的事故后被送往接受预防性医疗检查。
在71圈比赛的第45圈，博塔斯驾驶的凯迪拉克赛车右前悬挂在接近1号弯时突然失效，赛车打转后倒着撞上护栏。
比赛因需要修复护栏而中断，医疗团队也在座舱旁与博塔斯交谈了很长时间，最终他自行爬出赛车并步行离开。
凯迪拉克的一份声明称，博塔斯在车队无线电中“有回应”，将前往医疗中心接受“进一步的预防性医疗评估”。
在撞车发生时，车队无线电询问博塔斯是否还好，他回答说：“不。操！”
护栏修复完成后，比赛将恢复，马克斯·维斯塔潘将领先查尔斯·勒克莱尔。此前，这位红牛车手利用了勒克莱尔与杆位发车的法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第一圈颇具争议的事故。勒克莱尔因该事故受罚，将早期领先位置拱手让给了维斯塔潘。
汉密尔顿起初在博塔斯撞车引发安全车时进站，将第三名输给了很可能成为世界冠军的基米·安东内利，但比赛随后被红旗中断。不过，重启顺序按前一圈计算，这意味着汉密尔顿保住了第三名。
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has been taken for precautionary medical checks after a crash that caused Formula 1's Mexican Grand Prix to be red-flagged.
The right front suspension on Bottas's Cadillac dramatically failed as he approached Turn 1 on lap 45 of the 71-lap race, sending him spinning backwards into the barriers.
The race was stopped for the barriers to be repaired, with the medical team also spending a long time talking to Bottas in the cockpit before he eventually emerged and walked away unaided.
A Cadillac statement said Bottas was "responsive" on team radio and was going to the medical centre for "further medical assessments as a precaution".
Asked on team radio if he was OK as the crash unfolded, Bottas replied "no. F**k!".

Once barrier repairs are complete, the race will resume with Max Verstappen leading from Charles Leclerc after the Red Bull driver took advantage of a contentious first-lap incident between Leclerc and polesitting Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton. A penalty for Leclerc over that incident cost him his early lead to Verstappen.

Hamilton initially lost third to likely world champion Kimi Antonelli when he pitted as the safety car initially came out for Bottas's crash before the race was red-flagged instead. But the restart order has been counted from the lap before, meaning Hamilton keeps third.
keyPointsZh: 事故发生在71圈比赛的第45圈，博塔斯在进入1号弯时右前悬挂突然失效，赛车打转后撞上护栏。
医疗团队在座舱旁与博塔斯交谈许久，他最终自行爬出赛车并步行离开。
凯迪拉克车队声明称博塔斯在车队无线电中“有回应”，将前往医疗中心接受“进一步的预防性医疗评估”。
keyPointsEn: The crash occurred on lap 45 of the 71-lap race when the right front suspension on Bottas's Cadillac failed as he approached Turn 1, sending him spinning backwards into the barriers.
The medical team spent a long time talking to Bottas in the cockpit before he eventually emerged and walked away unaided.
A Cadillac statement said Bottas was "responsive" on team radio and was going to the medical centre for "further medical assessments as a precaution".
